_comment: SUFUN Firefox defaults. JSON has no comments, so they are here; Firefox ignores this key.
uBlock Origin (force-installed): blocks ads and trackers = less RAM and CPU per tab.
max_total_viewers=0: do not keep whole old pages in RAM for the Back button (Back reloads instead).
unloadOnLowMemory / processCount=4: fewer content processes, unload background tabs when RAM is low.
Site isolation (Fission) stays ON: it protects you from malicious sites.
VA-API on, AV1 off: the UHD 615 decodes VP9/H.264 in hardware but not AV1.
allow-pipewire: video calls can use the Surface cameras through PipeWire/libcamera.
